requirement.en: If there are 2 or more different Types among the face-up monsters on the field, send the top 2 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard.

effect.en: Face-up monsters on the field gain 500 ATK until the end of this turn. Then, you can add 1 monster with 900 ATK/100 DEF or 1 "Micha the Symbol of the Angels from your Graveyard to your hand. This turn, you cannot activate the effect of "Micha the Cheerful Angel".
